# Stage 18 Hybrid RAG Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** Add versioned semantic embeddings, PostgreSQL pgvector dense retrieval, BM25 lexical retrieval and deterministic rank fusion for validated tools without allowing unsupported metrics into RAG.

**Architecture:** Store one embedding row per validated tool in `semantic_embedding`, generated by FastEmbed `BAAI/bge-small-zh-v1.5` (512 dimensions). Dense candidates come from pgvector cosine search; lexical candidates come from BM25 over the same validated snapshot; exact/title/alias matches and RRF fusion produce the final candidate order.

**Tech Stack:** PostgreSQL 16 + pgvector, SQLAlchemy 2, FastEmbed ONNX, rank-bm25, existing ToolSnapshot/RAG registry.
